description: This file defines an abstract class PdfChoiceField for representing choice fields (such as dropdowns or list boxes) within PDF forms, including methods for managing options and their indices.

classes.name: PdfChoiceField
classes.description: Abstract base class for PDF choice form fields, providing functionalities to locate options within the /Opt array and retrieve values based on indices.

methods.name: IndexInOptArray
methods.description: Searches the /Opt array for a string or nested array matching the given value; returns its index or -1 if not found.

methods.name: ValueInOptArray
methods.description: Retrieves the string value at a specified index within the /Opt array, handling nested arrays.
